title: Hadayar da Aka Yi da Son Rai
intro: A lokacin jarabawar Allah, an kira rai zuwa ga aikin mika wuya na ƙarshe. An rene shi a cikin ƙasa mara ciyawa, wannan mutum ya girma ya nuna bangaskiya da haƙuri. Lokacin da wahayi ya ba da umarnin a yi hadaya, ba su yi shakka ba. Labarinsu ginshiƙi ne na ibada.
clues: Ni ne amsar addu'ar wani babban annabi da aka daɗe ana jira.
Ni da mahaifiyata mun bar su a cikin wani kwari mai cike da abubuwan sha da ruwa kawai.
Na girma har na zama annabi wanda aka san shi da gaskiya da haƙuri.
Na taimaki mahaifina wajen ɗaga harsashin wani gida mai tsarki da aka keɓe ga Allah.
Lokacin da mahaifina ya gaya mini mafarkin da zan yi hadaya da ni, sai na amsa, 'Ka yi kamar yadda aka umarce ka.'
Allah ya girmama mika wuyana ta hanyar aiko min da rago daga sama don ya fanshe ni.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Mika wuya da son rai don a yi masa sadaukarwa
Ana jefa shi cikin wuta mai zafi
Ana sayar da shi zuwa bauta
Ana gwada shi da rashin lafiya mai tsanani
trial.answer: Mika wuya da son rai don a yi masa sadaukarwa

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An fanshe shi da babban rago
An cece shi daga ambaliyar ruwa
An samo shi daga wurin shakatawa
An ba shi mulki da hikima
outcome.answer: An fanshe shi da babban rago

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
